title.quote:
The Three Regimes of Offline-to-Online Reinforcement
Learning
title.justification: Title appears at the top of the paper.
title.value: The Three Regimes of Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: A large-scale empirical study of offline-to-online reinforcement learning that proposes a stability-plasticity framework identifying three regimes (Superior, Comparable, Inferior) based on the relative performance of the pretrained policy and the offline dataset. The authors pretrain agents with CalQL, ReBRAC and BC(+FQE) on 21 D4RL dataset-task compositions and fine-tune them online with six representative design choices (warmup, offline RL regularization, offline data replay, reset, combinations), yielding 63 settings evaluated with 10 seeds each.

type.quote: We validate this framework through a large-scale empirical study, finding that the results strongly align with its predictions in 45 out of 63 cases
type.justification: The paper validates its framework through a large-scale empirical study over 63 settings.
